items.t: What Does Mastercard (MA) Joining The AI Transparency Initiative Mean For Investors?
items.sum: Mastercard (NYSE: MA) has joined Microsoft and more than 40 organizations in a new AI Transparency Initiative. The group plans to create shared standards for transparency, security, and governance of AI systems across multiple industries. items.t: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
items.sum: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.

items.t: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard disclose cyberattack on third-party vendors
items.sum: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard said on Thursday that some select customer data, including emails, was accessed by attackers after a cyberattack on a vendor.

items.t: Visa, Mastercard, JPMorgan Hit By Reported Data Leak, Payment Information Not Affected
items.sum: According to The Wall Street Journal, the breach reportedly involved a third-party service provider, but none of the three companies identified the provider.
